profile_text.body:
Fathom is a San Francisco-based company, founded in 2020, that offers an AI-powered meeting notetaker designed to capture, transcribe, and summarize calls held on Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams. The company describes itself as eliminating the need for manual note-taking, with a free tier for individuals and paid features for teams that include AI-powered CRM updates, smart action items, and an "Ask Fathom" search interface for querying meeting content and generating customizable summaries.

The core product, also called Fathom, sits in the notes, knowledge, and meetings category and includes features such as real-time AI Scorecards for call coaching, engagement tracking, and automatic syncing of call insights to connected business tools. Fathom also maintains a Model Context Protocol server, ai.fathom.api/mcp, described as giving AI assistants real meeting context so that outputs are grounded in a user's actual work.

The held facts show Fathom is registered as a public company with the SEC under CIK 0001762 and trades under the ticker FTHM. California is noted as the jurisdiction with the highest legal exposure, with 174 associated entries, though no specific litigation cases are recorded.
